beats.text: A holder locks 47.05M $WOJAK before the bid. Only tokens locked before a bid can vote on it.

beats.quote: WOJAK is smaller with a fat treasury and locked supply; bid modestly above fair, never overpay.
beats.text: Someone pays 0.05 NEAR to wake $PEPE's brain. It sizes up its rivals.

beats.quote: WOJAK holders: join the frog. Fair premium paid in NEAR-rich PEPE treasury, no overpay, real upside.
beats.text: $PEPE bids for $WOJAK: 0.9239 $PEPE per $WOJAK, 5.0% over the fair rate.
A late buyer locks 8.8M $WOJAK after the bid. The contract won't count those tokens on it.

beats.quote: Feels scary, but PEPE shares its treasury and brings a bigger community. Wojak never stops trying - let's ride this together.
beats.text: Someone wakes $WOJAK's brain. It tells its holders to vote YES.
A holder votes YES with 47.05M tokens locked before the bid.
Time's up and the vote has passed. Anyone can now tell $PEPE to carry it out.
$PEPE swallows $WOJAK. 2.05 NEAR of $WOJAK's curve and treasury moves into $PEPE.
2 holders swap 55.85M $WOJAK for $PEPE at 0.9239. $WOJAK lives on inside $PEPE.
